sents.en: In the Yuan dynasty China was very large.

sents.zh: 那时候的大王叫忽必烈。
sents.en: The great khan of that time was called Kublai.

sents.zh: 有一个人从很远的地方来。
sents.en: A man came from a place very far away.

sents.zh: 他叫马可·波罗，从意大利来。
sents.en: He was called Marco Polo, and he came from Italy.
He travelled for three years before he reached China.
He lived in Dadu for seventeen years.

sents.zh: 他看到很多城，也看到很多人。
sents.en: He saw many cities and many people.

sents.zh: 他说，中国的城比他家的城大很多。
sents.en: He said the cities of China were far bigger than his own.

sents.zh: 回国以后，他把看到的事写成了一本书。
sents.en: After going home, he wrote what he had seen into a book.

sents.zh: 欧洲人第一次知道了东边的世界。
sents.en: For the first time, people in Europe learned of the world to the east.
